liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Not Fade Away** (2 reviews): Features an unusually wide range of sounds and effects compared with other versions the reviewer has heard; Reviewer calls it epic, with Garcia wailing on guitar [6][11]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Garcia plays with great intensity, building up before the return to the 'flight of the seabird' section [8]
- **Sunrise** (1 review): Reviewer hears Donna at close to her best vocally [8]
- **Passenger** (1 review): Garcia plays hot slide guitar [8]
- **Bobby chatter: "Jerry's problem** (1 review): Bobby's stage talk explains why Garcia wasn't singing [14]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): A gentle reading, with sparse instrumentation during the jam [7]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Garcia's guitar playing compensates for his missing vocals, especially here [17]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer found it hot [17]

## Setlist highlights

- **absolutely perfect"/tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Bobby chatter: "Jerry's problem**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-07.aud.unknown.89474.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 159 min; rated 3.67/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: The audience recording sounds good, apart from Garcia's voice being missing; The taper turned the deck off between many songs, giving abrupt transitions between tracks [1][15]
- **gd1978-01-07.127345.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 168 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1978-01-07.sbd.clugston.7204.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 162 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd78-01-07.sbd.cotsman.17806.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 164 min; rated 4.15/5 by 13 [4]

## Around the show

- Garcia had laryngitis, so his guitar carried the vocal role all night [6]
- With no Garcia vocals, the whole band pushed harder, and even the drummers hit hard [7]
- Garcia is noticeably absent from the vocals [11]
- Reviewer notes an evening with only Bobby singing, guessing Garcia had lost his voice [13]
- Garcia had laryngitis [15]
- A Golden Hall events manager, last out in the early morning, saw a man in black suit and bowler hat on the top riser [16]
- Garcia sang no vocals because of laryngitis [3]
- Reviewer says the January 8 show has a much better recording, so download that night if choosing one [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-07.aud.unknown.89474.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Pantagruel; source: audience recording on a Marantz pro cassette deck, don't recall the model) & Sennheiser MKH404 mics [1]. Also: Quiet passages reveal a couple of analog generations in this audience recording's lineage [1]
- **gd1978-01-07.127345.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:17806) SBD>MC>R>D>CD>EAC>SHN patched with: AUD>?>CD>EAC>SHN final edits/encoding by JCotsman and Audience… [3]. Also: This is a matrix FLAC transfer, with show information embedded in each file's header tags [3]
- **gd1978-01-07.sbd.clugston.7204.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT> CDR [2]
- **gd78-01-07.sbd.cotsman.17806.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with audience patches [4]
